task: MPS capability and the MSA confound

text: MPS WAS ALREADY IN USE THROUGHOUT. Every Boltz-2 run in this project passed --accelerator gpu, which on this machine resolves to Apple MPS; torch reports mps.is_available() True, cuda False, and a measured 10.04 TFLOP/s fp32 on 4096^3 matmul. Mean per-fold wall clock across study #2 was 66.7 s. The panel's 'needs-gpu' label on study #10 was about SCALE (100-250 datacenter GPU-hours), not about whether a usable GPU exists here.

MEASURED FULL-MSA COST AND EFFECT. AChE (583 aa mature chain) + a 36-mer peptide with --use_msa_server takes 385.5 s against ~190 s in single-sequence mode, a 2.03x overhead. But the effect is not a cost-only change: ipTM for BasalAChE-GorgeBlock-B1 rose from 0.3402 to 0.7588, out of the band where study #7 measured 0 of 4 interfaces correct.

THIS UNDERMINES A REGISTERED CONFOUND OF STUDY #9, and the conclusion is now provisional. Study #9's plan stated that single-sequence mode 'depresses all arms equally, so the native-versus-decoy CONTRAST is the interpretable quantity'. Measured with MSA on one native and one decoy of the same candidate: native 0.3402 -> 0.7588, decoy0 0.3478 -> 0.2986. Without MSA the contrast was -0.008 (the decoy scored HIGHER); with MSA it is +0.460. MSA does NOT depress the arms equally — it separates them. The assumption was wrong, so #9's negative cannot be carried over to the MSA setting and must be re-run there.

SCOPE LIMIT ON STUDY #2's H3, now visible. Study #2 concluded that enabling the MSA server was immaterial for these designed sequences (mean shift 0.33 pLDDT units, 4 of 6 candidates bit-identical). That was measured on SINGLE-CHAIN folds, where a hand-assembled motif concatenation genuinely has no homologues to find. In a COMPLEX the MSA benefits the RECEPTOR — AChE has thousands of homologues — so the conclusion does not transfer. H3 was true as stated and is being misread if applied to complexes.

STUDY #10 IS FEASIBLE ON THIS HARDWARE, contrary to the panel's needs-gpu label. At the measured 385 s per full-MSA complex: 6 candidates x (1 native + 10 composition-matched decoys) = 66 folds = 7.1 hours, an overnight run. The 128 GB unified memory removes the VRAM ceiling that usually forces this work onto a datacenter card. What is NOT feasible is the panel's original 100-250 GPU-hour scope; what is feasible is a reduced design with enough decoys per candidate to reach an empirical p of 1/11 = 0.09.
